summary: On control/style-transfer: influence of the style image. 0 returns the input unchanged, 1 behaves as if no init image were passed.
combines: Applies only to a style-transfer or style-control operation with the required style reference image.
It combines with change strength, fidelity, the positive prompt, and any structure control. High values can overwhelm source preservation or other controls.
Lixpi sets it inside the chosen provider route. Exposing it separately without the operation and reference-role contract would create incompatible configurations.

usage.what: Applies the direct style-transfer reference at maximum influence. Bedrock does not receive this field.

note: Fixed internally when the direct API uses a style reference; not user-configurable.
